qualification_2.instrument_cause: The trusted client stopped capture at 64,001 raw NDJSON wire bytes before a terminal Ollama event. Stream-envelope overhead was incorrectly treated as if it approximated model payload size.
qualification_2.parser_error: JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 19 column 21 (char 1717)
qualification_2.transport_error: RuntimeError: raw response exceeded byte limit

scientific_boundary: This engineering failure neither supports nor falsifies SToE and does not establish gemma4 schema noncompliance because the trusted harness terminated the stream.
successor_correction: Future code uses a still-bounded 8,000,000-byte wire-capture limit and records RAW_CAPTURE_LIMIT_ABORT separately. Closed v2 call IDs and evidence are not retried or rewritten.
